translation.name: Dillꞌ wen dillꞌ   Kob C̱he   Jesucrístonaꞌ

content: Ḻi gakbe'i ka chaki X̱acho Chioza' cho' daa ne' nakcho xiiṉe'. Na' dii ḻi ba nakkzcho xiiṉen'. Daan, beṉ'ka' bi nonḻilall'gake' Chioza' bi chle'shi'gakile' cho', ḻa' bi nombia'gake'ne'.
Le' beṉ' bish'dawaa na' le' beṉ' zandawaa, ba nakcho xiiṉ Chios. Na' ḻa'kzi biṉ' iṉezyeṉ'icho nakan yiyakcho, ṉezicho kat' yila' Jesucrístona' yiyakcho ka nake', ḻa' ile'ichone' do ka nake'.
Na' nottez beena' ba none' lez dga, bich chone' txen dii mala' kwenc̱he gake' ka nak Jesucrístona', beena' bibi dii mal nda' nchene'.
Na' beena' chx̱iṉj chḻen chyishje' daa nllia Chioza' bia', ḻa' kat' chx̱iṉj chḻencho, xtilleenan' chyishjcho.
Le' ba ṉezile bid Jesucrístona' yell-lioni kwenc̱he bikwase' saaxya c̱hechoka', na' ṉezteile bibi saaxya c̱he' de.
Na' yog' beṉ'ka' nakgake'ne' toz bi chdagake' lao saaxyana'. San yog' beṉ'ka' chda lao saaxyana' biṉ' gakbe'gakile' non nak Crístona', ni bi nombia'gake'ne'.
Le' xiiṉdawaa, bi we'le latj no siye' le'. Beena' chon daa nak shḻi nake' beṉ' ḻi beṉ' shao' ka Jesucrístona' nake' beṉ' ḻi beṉ' shao'.
Na' beena' chx̱iṉj chḻen nake' xiiṉ dii x̱iwaa, ḻa' dii x̱iwaa bx̱iṉj bḻenan kana' zi' x̱e silte yell-lioni. Na' ni c̱heyi dgan bid Xiiṉ Chioza', kwenc̱he wlliayee yog'ḻoḻ daa chon dii x̱iwaa.
Beena' ba nak xiiṉ Chios bich chde' lao saaxyana', ḻa' Chioza' ba bikobe' yeḻ' mban c̱he'na'. Na' daa ba nake' xiiṉ Chioza', bich gak te' lao saaxyana'.
Na' nakbia' beṉ'ka' dii ḻicha nakgake' xiiṉ Chios na' beṉ'ka' nak xiiṉ dii x̱iwaa. Ḻa' nottez beena' bi chon daa nak shḻi na' bi chakile' bish' ljwelle'na' bi nake' xiiṉ Chios.
Kana' wzolotele bzenagle xtill' Crístona' benile dga: chiyaḻ' gaki bish' ljwellcho.

Bi chiyaḻ' goncho ka ben dii Caínna', bene' dii x̱iwaa txen na' bete' beṉ' bisheena'. Na' ¿bic̱he betze'ne'? Bete'ne' daa bentezi ben Caínna' dii mala', na' beṉ' bisheena' bene' daa chiyoolallii Chioza'.
Le' beṉ' bish'dawaa na' le' beṉ' zandawaa, bi gakllejile shi beṉ'ka' bi chajḻe' c̱he Chioza' chakzbangakile' le'.
Daa chakicho bish' ljwellchona' ṉezicho bich chdacho lo neza' gana' kwiayi'cho, san ba de yeḻ' mban c̱hecho zejḻi kaṉi. Ḻa' beena' bi chaki bish' ljwelle'na' ni zeje' lo neza' gana' kwiayee.
Nottez beṉ' chakzbanile' bish' ljwelle'na', lebzin chonlene' beṉ' wen xyana'. Na' ṉezile ni to wen xya bi de yeḻ' mban c̱he' zejḻi kaṉi.
Crístona' bliile' cho' ka nak yeḻ' chakina' daa bzani yeḻ' mban c̱he'na' ni c̱hecho. Na' ḻekzka' cho' chiyaḻ' izani yeḻ' mban c̱hechoni ni c̱he bish' ljwellchona'.
Shi ga zoacho chaj chdecho mbalaz na' chwiacho bish' ljwellchona' chyallj chc̱hinile' na' bi chiyesh'lallichone', ¿nakran goncho iṉacho chakicho Chioza'?
Le' xiiṉdawaa, bi chiyaḻ' gaki ljwellcho de cho'a dill'z, san chiyaḻ' wli'cho dii ḻi chaki ljwellcho.
Na' ṉezicho shi ba chaki ljwellcho, na' wli'n ba zejcho lo nez ḻina', na' ṉezicho Chioza' chibaile' ka choncho,
ḻa'kzi yic̱hjlall'do'choni iṉan nakcho beṉ' saaxya. Ḻa' Chioza' nakche' beṉ' choo beṉ' xench ka cho' na' ṉezile' yog'ḻoḻte.
Le' beṉ' bish'dawaa na' le' beṉ' zandawaa, shi yic̱hjlall'do'choni chakbe'in bibi xtoḻ'cho de, na' bi gall illebcho we'ḻwillchone',
na' goṉe' bittezə daa iṉabichone', ḻa' chzenagcho daa nllie' bia' goncho na' choncho ka chazlallee.
Na' dgan nllie' bia' goncho: gonḻilall'cho Xiiṉe' Jesucrístona', na' gaki ljwellcho ka ba bllie' bia' goncho.
Beṉ'ka' chongake' ka nllia Chioza' bia' ba nakgake'ne' toz na' zoalene' ḻegake'. Na' ṉezicho zoalene' cho' daa ba beṉe' Espíritu c̱he'na' zoe' ḻoo yic̱hjlall'do'choki.
